scope: 14 Legacy Era character-scale weapon claims only. No rolling authority mutation. No production mutation authorization.
inherits: Galaxy at War Phase 2C schema extensions

sourcePolicy.visualAuthority: Star Wars Saga Edition - Legacy Era Campaign Guide.pdf

schemaDelta.principle: Legacy Era extends the normalized authority only where published weapon mechanics cannot be represented faithfully by schema v2.5. No production migration is authorized.

requiredEdits.change: Add attackProfiles[].criticalEffects[] for source-defined critical-hit transformations of base dice, including die-size replacement without altering the persistent base weapon damage.
why: Hunting Blaster Carbine changes d8 weapon dice to d10s on a critical hit.
Heavy Assault Blaster Rifle changes d10 weapon dice to d12s on a critical hit.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append criticalEffects:[] by default to all prior attack profiles. Do not infer critical rules from repo traits or generic weapon families.

requiredEdits.change: Standardize existing conditionalQualities[] entries as {quality,state,when,scope,effect} so a published base quality can be disabled or enabled under a source condition.
why: Sporting Blaster Carbine is table-marked Inaccurate but is explicitly not treated as Inaccurate while wielded in two hands.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Keep [] by default. Backfill source-certified conditional Accurate/Inaccurate/Arc behavior only; never erase the underlying published table trait.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.technologyClassification {tags[], rules[]} for source-defined technology categories that alter repair, knowledge, modification, or other system interactions.
why: Razor Bug and Thud Bug are explicitly biotech devices. Biotech uses Treat Injury instead of Mechanics for repair, Knowledge (life sciences) instead of Knowledge (technology), has special Force interaction, and uses Biotech Specialist rather than Tech Specialist.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append {tags:[],rules:[]} by default. Populate only where a source explicitly classifies the item.

requiredEdits.change: Add canonicalStats.deliveryMethod to separate physical delivery from the rules range classification.
why: Razor Bugs and Thud Bugs are physically thrown by hand but explicitly use simple-weapon ranges rather than thrown-weapon ranges.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Append deliveryMethod:null by default. Do not set qualities.thrown merely because an object is physically hurled if the source assigns a different range classification.

requiredEdits.change: Extend attackProfiles[].preparedAttack with temporaryOverrides and unpreparedRestriction so preparation can temporarily change effective weapon size or firing eligibility without mutating base size.
why: Heavy Blaster Cannon is Huge; two swift actions immediately before the attack brace it, temporarily treating it as Large so a Medium wielder can fire it. Unbraced, Medium or smaller creatures cannot fire it.
requiredEdits.normalizePriorBooks: Keep preparedAttack:null by default. Existing prepared attacks such as Bryar priming remain compatible; add temporaryOverrides only when the source changes weapon properties/eligibility.

schemaDelta.sourceQualityRule: Legacy Era uses the standard Accurate rule (no short-range penalty) and Inaccurate rule (cannot attack at long range). Do not import Galaxy at War's stricter book-local Inaccurate behavior into Legacy records.

bookLocalGuardrails: Do not update a rolling/master weapon authority from this package.
Do not mutate production packs, template/schema runtime, actors, feats, or talents during certification.
Do not create Shock Whip or Tehkla Blade during this phase.
Repo fields are comparison evidence only.
Do not make Long-Handle Lightsaber permanently two-handed.
Do not treat physical throwing of Razor Bug/Thud Bug as thrown-weapon range classification.
Do not erase the table-level Inaccurate trait from Sporting Blaster Carbine; model the two-handed exception conditionally.
Do not import Galaxy at War's stricter Inaccurate behavior; Legacy defines Inaccurate as no Long-range attacks.
Do not drop Jedi Academy's Long Haft Form rule from the shared Long-Handle Lightsaber identity merely because the Legacy entry is shorter.
